deliveroo.source: sales + orders: Deliveroo Tax Invoice PDF (Total Order Value), issued 09/11/2026 + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Sales were down 3.6% on the week before, with deliveries and covers also down.
The daily report and the printed till Z report did not match because the till report includes the service charge.
Wages were 19.4% because of ongoing training, and a new starter needed only one day of training on the new app.
Food cost was 21.4% with a food variance of 0.41, the first time FOH had entered the BOH food variance, so the numbers are being double checked.

Loyalty usage dropped to 80%, and customers are exploiting the birthday ramen reward by deleting and recreating accounts; linking phone numbers to accounts is not yet live, and an ID check in the terms and conditions was suggested as a stop gap.
Delivery prep times were just over 15 minutes while new staff get used to packing and pressing the ready button.
A one star review came from a table of six who ordered bubble tea when the ingredients were out of stock.
Staffing: two BOH team members are on holiday until February, with one month of full time cover arranged and the rest still being worked out.
Site compliance was 95%, while the grease trap repair and a roof hole waiting on Chris are still outstanding.
Promotions: Slerp 30% off, Deliveroo 30% off from next week, the Christmas menu and the app free drink welcome voucher.
Maki 1 has not received its cookbooks because it was not on the initial distribution list.
Claims of six people sharing the same birthday were investigated as loyalty fraud, and the bubble tea stock out complaint was handled by retraining staff (AM Updates meeting 11/11).
Maki 1 beat its sales target, though spend per head stayed low (AM Updates meeting 11/11).
actions: Remind staff to tell customers clearly when ingredients are out of stock - Owner: Maki 1 GM (17/11/2026)
Make sure staff press ready on delivery orders as soon as they are packed - Owner: Maki 1 GM (17/11/2026)
Ask Ross for a status update on the grease trap repair - Owner: Maki 1 GM (17/11/2026)
